comparison.objective: Dry-fit a mortise-and-tenon frame corner and secure it with a peg.
comparison.physical_skill: Constrained joint alignment, insertion, seating, and pegging rather than rotational adjustment and setscrew locking.
comparison.success_condition: Assembled pegged frame corner versus two dynamically acceptable stops with setting retention. Fit, seating, and force thresholds are not supplied.
comparison.reason: Both demand precision, but they test different abilities: structural joint assembly versus iterative tuning and verification of an energy absorber.
